title_zh: 苹果发布 M6 MacBook Pro 和 iMac
content_zh:
苹果发布搭载 M6 芯片的 MacBook Pro 和 iMac，国行起售价 分别为 15999 元、12499 元。

M6 配备 12 核 CPU 和 12 核 GPU，相比 M5 各增加 2 核，GPU 每个核心均带有神经网络加速器，并配备双 16 核神经网络引擎。苹果称，相比 M5，图形性能最高提升 30%，端侧 AI 工作负载性能最高提升 25%。

MacBook Pro 标配 16GB 统一内存，最高可选 32GB，内存带宽为 170GB/s。

iMac 外观则延续 24 英寸一体机设计，提供蓝、绿、粉、黄、紫、橙、银七种配色，配备 4.5K 视网膜显示屏；最高配备 4 个雷雳 4 端口，并支持最多 2 台 6K 外接显示器。
title_en: Apple Unveils M6 MacBook Pro and iMac with AI-Boosted Performance
content_en:
Apple has officially launched its updated MacBook Pro and 24-inch iMac, powered by the next-generation M6 chip. In China, starting prices are set at RMB 15,999 for the MacBook Pro and RMB 12,499 for the iMac.

The new M6 chip features a 12-core CPU and a 12-core GPU—adding two cores to each over the M5—alongside dual 16-core Neural Engines and neural accelerators integrated into every GPU core. Apple highlights an up to 30% boost in graphics performance and a 25% improvement in on-device AI workloads compared to its predecessor.

The MacBook Pro comes standard with 16GB of unified memory (configurable up to 32GB) delivering a memory bandwidth of 170GB/s. Meanwhile, the 24-inch iMac retains its sleek all-in-one design across seven vibrant colors, featuring a 4.5K Retina display, up to four Thunderbolt 4 ports, and support for up to two external 6K displays.

title_zh: iPhone 18 Pro 上市三周在华销量增 29%，美国与日本下滑
content_zh:
Counterpoint Research 10 月 27 日公布的周度销量追踪显示，iPhone 18 Pro 系列上市前三周的全球销量较上一代同期增长 3.1%，主要增量来自中国市场：在华销量同比增长 29%，美国、日本市场则均出现下滑。

该机构认为，中国市场受益于上市初期供货改善，以及安卓竞品旗舰机型涨价。美国消费者对新机功能、设计升级的感知较弱；日本市场则受到汇率放大涨价幅度的影响。

iPhone 18 Pro Max 占本代 Pro 系列销量的 56%，略低于上一代的 57%。Counterpoint 副总监林秀晶表示，中国市场的强势是否来自提前集中购机，还需后续数周观察；iPhone Duo 能带来新增需求，还是分流 Pro Max，也是短期变量。
title_en: iPhone 18 Pro Sales Surge 29% in China, Offsetting Slumps in US and Japan
content_en:
Global sales for the iPhone 18 Pro series rose 3.1% year-over-year during its first three weeks on the market, according to weekly tracking data from Counterpoint Research. Strong demand in China was the primary growth driver, where sales surged 29%, contrasting with declines in both the United States and Japan.

Analysts attribute China's strong momentum to improved initial supply and price hikes among competing Android flagships. Conversely, US consumers perceived fewer notable upgrades in features and design, while exchange rate fluctuations magnified price increases in Japan.

The top-tier iPhone 18 Pro Max accounted for 56% of total Pro series sales, slightly down from 57% in the previous generation. Counterpoint analyst HyoJin Lim noted that it remains to be seen whether China's strong early performance reflects sustained demand or front-loaded purchasing, while the market impact of the new iPhone Duo remains another key variable.

title_zh: 有线电视与 IPTV 新规：不得播放开机广告，首页须设免费专区
content_zh:
国家广播电视总局 10 月 27 日公布《有线广播电视运营服务管理规定》和《交互式网络电视运营服务管理暂行规定》，两份规章均将于 11 月 27 日施行。

新规要求相关运营服务提供者坚持直播优先，实现开机看全屏直播、设置频道回看入口，不得播放开机广告。用户应能通过便捷入口，自行选择开机进入直播或电视交互主页；智能电视机也须支持优先呈现直播频道。

在收费和操作方面，有线电视与 IPTV 首页须设立免费专区，重点推荐优质免费内容，精简收费栏目并明示收费信息；遥控器应能一键切换直播信源，终端还须持续缩短开机时长。
title_en: China Bans Startup Ads on Cable TV and IPTV, Mandates Free Content Zones
content_en:
China’s National Radio and Television Administration has issued new operational regulations for cable TV and IPTV services, set to take effect on November 27. The rules strictly prohibit boot-up advertisements and mandate that service providers prioritize live TV broadcasts.

Under the guidelines, platforms must allow users to boot directly into full-screen live TV or easily set their default start page. Smart TVs are also required to prioritize live broadcast channels, while remote controls must feature a dedicated button for one-touch source switching.

To improve user experience and transparency, operators must establish a dedicated free content zone on homepages to highlight non-paid programming. Additionally, service providers are instructed to streamline paid subscription categories, clearly display pricing details, and continually reduce device boot times.

title_zh: IDC：中国手机 Q3 出货下滑 15.2%，折叠屏连续四季度下降
content_zh:
IDC 10 月 27 日发布的季度跟踪报告显示，今年第三季度中国智能手机市场出货量约 5806 万台，同比下降 15.2%，降幅较上半年约 4% 进一步扩大。

IDC 将市场概括为「量跌价升」：存储及其他元器件成本上涨传导至终端，厂商调整配置、提高定价，消费者则延长换机周期。华为市场份额升至 21.1%，出货量保持同比两位数增长；荣耀是头部主流厂商中唯一实现出货量环比正增长的品牌。

折叠屏的调整更明显，第三季度中国市场出货约 177 万台，同比下降 32.7%，已连续四个季度下滑。华为在该市场的份额超过 70%，三星与小米分列其后。IDC 预计，随着苹果入局、更多品牌推出阔折叠新品，国内折叠屏市场将从下一季度起回暖。
title_en: China Smartphone Shipments Drop 15.2% in Q3 as Foldable Market Shrinks
content_en:
China's smartphone market saw shipments drop 15.2% year-on-year to roughly 58.06 million units in the third quarter, according to a report by IDC. The decline marks a sharp acceleration from the approximately 4% drop recorded in the first half of the year.

IDC characterized the market shift as "falling volume and rising prices." Rising costs for memory and other components led manufacturers to tweak device specifications and hike prices, prompting consumers to extend their phone upgrade cycles. Amid the downturn, Huawei's market share climbed to 21.1% with double-digit year-on-year growth, while Honor was the only major vendor to post positive quarter-on-quarter growth.

The foldable smartphone segment experienced a steeper contraction, with shipments dropping 32.7% year-on-year to 1.77 million units—marking four consecutive quarters of decline. Huawei maintained a dominant market share exceeding 70%, followed by Samsung and Xiaomi. However, IDC projects a market rebound starting next quarter, driven by new wide-fold releases and Apple's anticipated entry into the space.

title_zh: 张一鸣以 6700 亿元登顶胡润百富榜，梁文锋首次上榜排第七
content_zh:
胡润研究院 10 月 27 日发布《2026 胡润百富榜》，字节跳动创始人张一鸣以 6700 亿元财富第二次成为中国首富，较去年增加 2000 亿元，并刷新榜单的中国首富财富纪录。

农夫山泉创始人钟睒睒以 4100 亿元退居第二。DeepSeek 创始人梁文锋首次上榜，以 2800 亿元位列第七；宇树科技创始人王兴兴也首次上榜，财富为 695 亿元。

本次榜单共有 1529 位个人财富 50 亿元以上的企业家，比去年增加 95 位，总财富为 32 万亿元。胡润称，半导体、人工智能、机器人等行业是今年财富增长较突出的领域。榜单的财富计算截止日为 9 月 1 日，采用公开股权、市场价值及调研信息进行估算。
title_en: ByteDance Founder Zhang Yiming Tops Hurun Rich List with Record Wealth
content_en:
ByteDance founder Zhang Yiming has claimed the top spot on the Hurun China Rich List with a fortune of 670 billion RMB, up 200 billion RMB from last year. This marks his second time as China's wealthiest individual and sets a new record for the highest net worth recorded on the list.

Nongfu Spring founder Zhong Shanshan dropped to second place with 410 billion RMB. Meanwhile, emerging tech leaders made strong debuts: DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng entered the list at seventh place with 280 billion RMB, while Unitree Robotics founder Wang Xingxing debuted with 69.5 billion RMB.

Overall, the list features 1,529 individuals with a minimum personal wealth of 5 billion RMB—an increase of 95 from last year—holding a combined net worth of 32 trillion RMB. Hurun noted that sectors such as semiconductors, artificial intelligence, and robotics drove the most prominent wealth gains over the past year.

title_zh: 邓煜：AI 公司应公开证明思路，让用户决定数据是否用于训练
content_zh:
数学家邓煜在 10 月 25 日由《知识分子》《赛先生》联合举办的论坛演讲中谈到，AI 对数学研究有很大促进作用，但提供模型的公司同样需要面对学术规范、思想来源和用户权益问题。

他认为，如果把 AI 当作发表研究成果的研究者，就应解释重大证明是如何得到的，说明其中沿用了哪些人的思路。数学家报告成果时需要回答这些问题，AI 公司也应公开相应思维链，不能仅以防止蒸馏为由拒绝。

从商业关系看，邓煜质疑：数学家付费使用工具、输入研究思路后，模型提供方再利用这些思路训练产品并发布成果，用户的贡献应如何得到承认？他主张，是否允许输入数据参与训练，应由用户自行选择。

他同时强调，数学家不应拒绝使用 AI，而应把它作为推进研究的工具，由人提出问题、把握方向。他提出的方案包括建立思路和贡献的追溯机制，让成果能够说明某个想法最初由谁提出。
title_en: Mathematician Yu Deng Calls for AI Transparency and User Data Rights
content_en:
Mathematician Yu Deng emphasized during a recent academic forum that while AI significantly accelerates mathematical research, AI developers must adhere to established academic standards, respect intellectual attribution, and safeguard user rights.

Deng argued that if an AI model acts as a research collaborator publishing mathematical results, companies must disclose the underlying logic and chain of thought behind major proofs. He stressed that AI firms should not withhold these insights under the pretext of preventing model distillation, as citing prior intellectual contributions is a fundamental requirement in academic research.

Furthermore, Deng raised ethical concerns regarding commercial user relationships, pointing out that paying users who input research ideas into models deserve proper recognition. He advocated for a clear attribution mechanism for intellectual contributions and insisted that users should have the right to decide whether their data can be used for model training.

title_zh: 研究：豆包引用抖音的权重升至 31.8%
content_zh:
新榜服务发布的 AI 信源研究显示，在其监测样本中，豆包对抖音内容的引用权重由今年 5 月的 10.79% 升至 8 月的 31.8%，接近三分之一。

报告还称，百度在 6 月首次将 B 站和好看视频纳入所监测的引用信源，两者权重合计达到 12%；到 8 月，B 站权重稳定在 8.4%，排在第二位。

新榜进一步分析视频标题与引用次数的关系，发现标题与问题的语义相关性、是否包含品牌和专业术语，比单纯增加标题长度或堆砌规格数字更有解释力。这些结果来自新榜智汇的监测与统计，反映所覆盖问题和内容样本中的引用分布。
title_en: Study: ByteDance’s Doubao AI Surges Reliance on Douyin to 31.8%
content_en:
ByteDance’s AI assistant Doubao has significantly increased its reliance on Douyin content, according to a recent AI source tracking study by New Rank. The proportion of citations referencing Douyin content jumped from 10.79% in May to 31.8% in August, accounting for nearly one-third of total sources analyzed.

Meanwhile, Baidu expanded its source monitoring in June to include Bilibili and Haokan Video, which initially made up a combined 12% share. By August, Bilibili stabilized at an 8.4% citation weight, securing the second spot among Baidu's referenced platforms.

The report also analyzed video title structures, noting that high semantic relevance to user queries, alongside the inclusion of brand names and technical terms, plays a far more critical role in citation frequency than mere title length or keyword stuffing.

title_zh: 大众在海外召回约 7.27 万辆电动车，部分车型充电上限暂降至 80%
content_zh:
据第一财经报道，德国联邦汽车运输管理局公布的三批召回备案，合计涉及约 7.27 万辆大众集团电动车，包括部分大众 ID.3、ID.4、ID.7、ID.Buzz 和 Cupra Born，原因是高压电池电芯存在安全隐患。

大众英国官网确认，使用特定供应商于 2022 至 2025 年生产的高压电池的部分 ID.3、ID.4、ID.7 需要检查；电量超过 80% 时，电池可能过热并有起火风险。厂商已通过远程方式为多数受影响车辆暂时设置 80% 充电上限，后续将通知车主检查，必要时更换电池模组。

大众英国未披露供应商名称。第一财经指出，美国另一起涉及 22524 辆 ID.4 的召回文件将供应商列为 SK On，但不能据此认定所有地区涉事电池均来自该企业。报道发布时，中国市场尚未公布此次 ID. 系列召回公告。
title_en: VW Recalls 72,700 EVs Internationally Over Battery Fire Risk, Caps Charging at 80%
content_en:
Volkswagen Group is recalling roughly 72,700 electric vehicles across international markets due to potential fire hazards stemming from high-voltage battery cell defects. According to filings from Germany’s Federal Motor Transport Authority (KBA), the recall impacts several models, including the ID.3, ID.4, ID.7, ID.Buzz, and Cupra Born.

Volkswagen UK confirmed that affected vehicles produced between 2022 and 2025 face overheating risks if charged beyond 80%. To mitigate immediate dangers, the automaker has issued an over-the-air (OTA) software update temporarily capping the maximum charge limit to 80%. Vehicle owners will subsequently be instructed to visit service centers for battery module inspections and potential replacements.

While VW has not officially named the battery supplier involved in the European recall, US regulatory filings for a separate recall of 22,524 ID.4 vehicles listed South Korea's SK On. No recall announcements have been issued for the Chinese market as of publication.

title_zh: 《宝可梦大集结》海外版将于明年 3 月停服，保留资料馆
content_zh:
《Pokémon UNITE》日本官网 10 月 27 日公告，Nintendo Switch 版和手机版将于明年 3 月 23 日日本时间 9 时、即北京时间 8 时结束服务。官方当日已停止宝石销售，以及 UNITE 会员的新订阅和自动续费；现有宝石与会员权益可在相应期限内继续使用。

官方计划于 11 月 12 日加入「资料馆」功能，让玩家在停服后仍能查看已获得的电子服、时装、成就和部分比赛记录。玩家需要在服务结束前下载相关资料，停服后将无法再下载缺失数据。

此前公布的 Pokémon UNITE Aeos Crown 2027 Tokyo 赛事仍将按计划举办。未使用的付费宝石将在停服后开放退款申请，具体流程由官方另行说明。本次公告针对海外版。
title_en: Pokémon UNITE International Service to Shut Down in March 2025
content_en:
The international versions of *Pokémon UNITE* on Nintendo Switch and mobile platforms will officially end service on March 23, 2025, at 9:00 AM JST, according to an official announcement. Sales of Aeos Gems and UNITE Membership renewals have been suspended, though existing balances and active benefits remain usable until the final shutdown.

To allow players to preserve their progress, the developer will introduce an "Archive" feature on November 12. This tool will enable players to view unlocked Holowear, fashion items, achievements, and select match history offline. Players must download their data before the service terminates, as data cannot be retrieved afterward.

Despite the upcoming shutdown, the previously announced Pokémon UNITE Aeos Crown 2027 Tokyo tournament will proceed as planned. Refunds for unused paid currency will be processed after the servers go offline. This announcement specifically applies to the game's overseas service.

title_zh: 红果否认「年收入 400 亿元」传闻，称大部分收入用于内容投入
content_zh:
红果短剧 10 月 27 日发布声明，否认网络流传的「年化收入逼近 400 亿元」「今年营收达 420 亿元至 450 亿元」等说法，称相关收入数据不实。

声明指出，网传内容援引的「机构数据」「行业数据」「专家预计」均非官方信息，由此作出的比较、推算和延伸解读也没有事实依据。

红果同时表示，目前平台大部分收入持续用于内容创作者分账、版权保底和优质内容扶持。
title_en: Hongguo Short Drama Refutes 40 Billion Yuan Annual Revenue Rumors
content_en:
Hongguo Short Drama issued an official statement on October 27 denying online rumors that its annual revenue is approaching 40 billion yuan or could reach 42 billion to 45 billion yuan this year, calling the figures entirely inaccurate.

The platform clarified that third-party data, industry reports, and expert projections cited online are unofficial and lack any factual foundation for calculation or comparison.

Hongguo added that the majority of its revenue continues to be reinvested into content creation, including creator profit-sharing, copyright guarantees, and support for high-quality content.

title_zh: 小米武汉首个员工住宅开盘，297 套房限内部员工购买
content_zh:
据《21 世纪经济报道》报道，小米在武汉的首个员工住宅项目「光谷梦享家」已开盘，项目规划 4 栋住宅、共 297 套房源，备案均价为每平方米 13885 元，购房对象限定为小米体系内已签订劳动合同、正常缴纳社保的在职正式员工。

项目距离小米武汉科技园约 700 米，提供约 110 平方米、122—125 平方米的三房，以及约 143 平方米的四房，按毛坯标准交付。报道援引小米生态链总经理陈波的介绍称，从项目步行到科技园需 10 分钟左右。

武汉市住房和城市更新局公示的预售资料显示，项目于 10 月 16 日取得预售许可，开发主体为小米全资子公司谧空间武汉信息科技有限公司，计划于 2028 年 5 月交付。
title_en: Xiaomi Launches First Employee Housing Project in Wuhan, Exclusive to Internal Staff
content_en:
Xiaomi has opened sales for its first employee residential housing development in Wuhan, named "Optics Valley Dream Home," according to *21st Century Business Herald*. The project comprises 297 units across four buildings, with a registered average price of 13,885 yuan per square meter. Purchase eligibility is strictly limited to full-time Xiaomi employees with valid employment contracts and active social security contributions.

Located approximately 700 meters from the Xiaomi Wuhan Technology Park—about a 10-minute walk—the project offers three-bedroom units (110 and 122–125 square meters) and four-bedroom units (143 square meters), delivered as unfurnished shells.

Pre-sale regulatory filings indicate that the project obtained its pre-sale permit on October 16. Developed by MiSpace Wuhan Information Technology, a wholly owned subsidiary of Xiaomi, the residential complex is scheduled for delivery in May 2028.

title_zh: AMD 将向 Meta 投资 10 亿美元，Helios 机架已安装测试
content_zh:
AMD 宣布将参与 Meta 的股权发行，投资 10 亿美元。双方同时披露算力合作进展：首批 Helios 机架级系统已在 Meta 安装并进行测试，后续计划扩大部署。

AMD 的 EPYC 处理器为 Meta 的 Muse 个人 AI 智能体提供专用计算环境。Meta 已部署数百万颗不同代际的 EPYC，并成为第六代 EPYC 的首批重要客户；双方还在合作开发后续平台。

在 GPU 端，Meta 已将 Instinct 用于训练、排序与推荐系统，并计划部署针对自身工作负载优化的定制 GPU。软件合作覆盖 PyTorch、Triton 和 ROCm；Muse Spark Open 已获得 Instinct 首日支持，Muse Glimmer 则支持 Ryzen AI PC 与 Radeon GPU。
title_en: AMD to Invest $1 Billion in Meta, Expands AI Computing Partnership
content_en:
AMD has announced a $1 billion investment in Meta by participating in its equity offering. Alongside the financial commitment, the two tech giants revealed significant progress in their hardware partnership, with initial Helios rack-level systems already installed and undergoing testing at Meta ahead of a wider rollout.

Meta relies extensively on AMD's EPYC processors to power its Muse personal AI agent, having deployed millions of EPYC CPUs across multiple generations. Meta is also among the key launch customers for the 6th-generation EPYC chips, and both companies are actively co-developing future platform architectures.

On the GPU side, Meta utilizes AMD Instinct accelerators for model training, ranking, and recommendation engines, with plans to deploy customized GPUs tailored to its specific workloads. The technical collaboration also spans software optimization across PyTorch, Triton, and ROCm, extending support for Meta's Muse AI models across AMD's enterprise GPUs and consumer PCs.

title_zh: Meta AI 总监离职创办 Ndoc，想把文档、数据与演示放进同一工作区
content_zh:
据 TechCrunch 对罗希特·帕特尔（Rohit Patel）的采访，这位在 Meta 工作约 8 年的超级智能实验室前总监已离职，创办 AI 原生办公软件 Ndoc，希望把 Excel、Word、PowerPoint 等工具间分散的工作整合到同一界面。

Ndoc 将工作区分为三部分：Stage 展示幻灯片、仪表盘和迷你应用；Narrative 放分析、编号引用和图表；Model 保存底层数据集与 Python 脚本。用户上传数据后，可让 AI 分析并生成说明，也能检查计算脚本，或请 AI 解释公式所在的代码。

帕特尔称，文档可导出为浏览器能打开的单个「.ndoc.html」文件，他计划开放这一格式。团队目前有 3 人、尚未融资，正在开展企业试点，并向候补名单中的少量客户开放 alpha 版；注册免费，使用与 Token 消耗收费。beta 版计划在未来数周推出，完整产品计划明年发布。
title_en: Ex-Meta AI Director Launches Ndoc to Unify Docs, Data, and Presentations
content_en:
Rohit Patel, former Director at Meta’s Superintelligence Lab, has departed after eight years to launch **Ndoc**, an AI-native productivity tool designed to consolidate fragmented workflows across Excel, Word, and PowerPoint into a single workspace.

The Ndoc workspace is structured into three key zones:
* **Stage:** Displays slides, dashboards, and mini-applications.
* **Narrative:** Features in-depth analysis, numbered citations, and charts.
* **Model:** Houses underlying datasets and custom Python scripts.

Users can upload data for AI analysis, script verification, and formula explanations. Ndoc documents export as standalone `.ndoc.html` files, a format Patel plans to open-source. Operating with a three-person team, Ndoc is currently unfunded and running enterprise pilots alongside a limited alpha launch, with a beta expected in the coming weeks.

title_zh: 金山办公 Q3 归母净利降 72.3%，经调整净利增 8.44%
content_zh:
金山办公 10 月 27 日披露三季报，第三季度营业收入为 17.66 亿元，同比增长 16.11%；归母净利润为 1.19 亿元，同比下降 72.3%，主要受对外投资基金项目投资收益降低影响。扣非净利润为 1.14 亿元，同比下降 72.85%。

公司披露的经调整归母净利润为 5.39 亿元，同比增长 8.44%。这一口径剔除了股份支付费用、基金相关投资收益，以及这些调整事项对应的所得税影响。

分业务来看：

第三季度经营活动现金流量净额为 4.67 亿元，同比下降 13.23%。截至 9 月底，WPS Office 全球月度活跃设备数为 6.78 亿，其中 PC 版为 3.41 亿，移动版为 3.37 亿。
title_en: Kingsoft Office Q3 Net Profit Drops 72.3% on Investment Losses, Adjusted Earnings Rise 8.44%
content_en:
Kingsoft Office released its Q3 financial results, reporting revenue of 1.766 billion yuan, up 16.11% year-over-year. However, net profit attributable to the parent company dropped 72.3% to 119 million yuan, largely impacted by declining returns from external investment funds.

On an adjusted basis—which excludes share-based compensation, fund investment returns, and related tax impacts—net profit actually grew 8.44% year-over-year to 539 million yuan.

Net operating cash flow for the quarter stood at 467 million yuan, down 13.23% year-over-year. Meanwhile, global monthly active devices for WPS Office reached 678 million by the end of September, split between 341 million on PC and 337 million on mobile.

title_zh: 💡 微软 CEO 纳德拉：AI 更强，并不会自动变得更安全
content_zh:
微软 CEO 萨提亚·纳德拉在 20VC 播客中说，他改变了一个过去相信的判断：模型能力提升后，AI 与人类目标的对齐会自然出现。这里的「对齐」，指让 AI 的行为符合人类的价值与目标。

据《商业内幕》对访谈的报道，主持人 Harry Stebbings 问他，过去一年改变了什么看法。纳德拉回答，模型扩展和能力进步大体符合他的预期，但对齐仍是一项独立的挑战。

纳德拉此前于 10 月 10 日提出，企业应把 AI 模型当作潜在的内部威胁，并假设模型可能已被攻陷。对企业部署而言，他给出的办法是在非确定性模型外建立确定性的系统设计、人类控制和可靠的操作流程；现有行业标准不足时，还需要制定新标准。
title_en: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella Warns Smarter AI Won't Automatically Be Safer
content_en:
Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella revealed on the *20VC* podcast that he has shifted his stance on AI alignment—the practice of ensuring AI behavior aligns with human values and goals. Nadella admitted he previously believed alignment would naturally occur as models improved, but now views it as an independent challenge separate from model scaling.

Nadella advised enterprises to treat AI models as potential insider threats and operate under the assumption that models could be compromised.

To safeguard deployments, he recommended building deterministic system safeguards, human oversight, and reliable operational controls around non-deterministic AI models, while advocating for new industry standards to bridge safety gaps.

title_zh: 2999 元起，REDMI K100 发布：10000mAh 电池配双芯
content_zh:
REDMI K100 于 10 月 27 日发布并开启预售，标准版首次搭载游戏独显 D2，配合高通骁龙 8 至尊版，主打游戏性能和大电池续航。

手机配备 6.83 英寸直屏，支持 165Hz 刷新率、全亮度 DC 调光及 3500nits 峰值亮度。官方称，屏幕已原生适配超过 40 款高帧率游戏，独显芯片可用于超分辨率与超帧处理。

续航方面，K100 内置 10000mAh 电池，支持 100W 有线快充及 27W 有线反充。小米实验室给出的 DOU 续航测试结果为 2.43 天。其他配置包括 5000 万像素主摄、3D 超声波指纹，以及出厂搭载的小米澎湃 OS 4。

12GB + 256GB、12GB + 512GB、16GB + 512GB 三个版本的双 11 限时特惠价分别为 2999 元、3499 元和 3899 元；首档叠加国补后的价格为 2549.15 元。新机将于 10 月 31 日 10 时正式开售，提供黑色、雪岩白和流萤绿三种配色。
title_en: REDMI K100 Launches with Dual Chips and Huge 10,000mAh Battery
content_en:
REDMI officially unveiled the K100 smartphone on October 27, focusing on high-end gaming performance and class-leading battery life. The device combines Qualcomm's Snapdragon 8 Elite processor with a dedicated D2 display chip to enhance resolution and frame rates across more than 40 native games.

The smartphone features a 6.83-inch flat display with a 165Hz refresh rate, full-brightness DC dimming, and a peak brightness of 3,500 nits. Its standout feature is a massive 10,000mAh battery supporting 100W fast charging and 27W reverse charging, offering up to 2.43 days of battery life according to Xiaomi lab tests.

Rounding out the specifications are a 50MP main camera, a 3D ultrasonic fingerprint sensor, and pre-installed Xiaomi HyperOS 4. The REDMI K100 goes on sale October 31, with promotional launch pricing starting at 2,999 RMB (effective as low as 2,549.15 RMB with regional subsidies).

title_zh: REDMI Book 2027 换新模具，14 英寸轻至 1.28kg
content_zh:
REDMI 在 10 月 27 日的发布会上推出 Book 2027 系列，这是该数字系列时隔三年的模具更新。新品有 14 英寸和 16 英寸两种尺寸，提供月光银、深空灰、星云紫和海风蓝四种配色；14 英寸机型轻至 1.28kg，机身最厚处为 13.95mm。

系列搭载第三代英特尔酷睿处理器、LPDDR5X 7467MT/s 内存，采用双风扇散热，官方称整机稳定性能释放最高 30W。内置 72Wh 电池，官方模拟办公续航为 20.2 小时，标配 68W USB-C 电源适配器。

软件预装超级小爱 2.0，可调用小米 MiMo 模型完成 PPT、网页数据看板等任务；小米笔记 PC 版支持与手机、平板同步，也支持米家远程开关机和平板远程控制。新品已开启预约，11 月 3 日发售，14 英寸酷睿 5 320、16GB + 512GB 版本在适用地区的国补到手价为 5779.15 元。
title_en: REDMI Book 2027 Debuts Redesigned Chassis and Lightweight Build
content_en:
REDMI introduced its Book 2027 laptop lineup on October 27, marking the series' first chassis redesign in three years. Available in 14-inch and 16-inch options, the 14-inch model highlights ultra-portability, weighing just 1.28kg with a slim 13.95mm profile.

Powered by 3rd Gen Intel Core processors and high-speed LPDDR5X memory, the series utilizes a dual-fan thermal system capable of delivering up to 30W sustained performance. It packs a 72Wh battery rated for up to 20.2 hours of productivity and includes a 68W USB-C charger.

For intelligent productivity, the devices come pre-installed with Super XiaoAI 2.0, powered by Xiaomi's MiMo AI model to assist with creating presentations and data dashboards. Pre-orders are open ahead of the official release on November 3, with subsidized pricing starting at 5,779.15 RMB for the base 14-inch model.

title_zh: Rokid 新眼镜接入微信，手势戒指可盲操回复与翻页
content_zh:
在 10 月 27 日的 Rokid Jungle 2026 发布会上，乐奇展示了新一代 AI 眼镜与配套交互：Rokid Glasses 2、双目全彩眼镜 Rokid Color，以及智能戒指「乐奇魔戒」。

乐奇已将微信接入眼镜端。收到消息后，通知可显示在镜片视野中，用户可通过语音，或搭配戒指的指尖手势确认并回复消息。

「乐奇魔戒」支持轻触、双击、滑动和长按等操作，可用于提词器翻页、切歌、抓拍以及确认 AI 指令，减少触摸镜腿或在公共场所开口操作的需要。
title_en: Rokid Unveils AI Smart Glasses with WeChat Integration and Gesture Ring
content_en:
At its Rokid Jungle 2026 event on October 27, Rokid showcased its next-generation AI wearables, including the Rokid Glasses 2, the binocular full-color Rokid Color glasses, and a companion smart gesture ring.

A key feature of the new lineup is deep WeChat integration. Incoming messages appear directly within the user's field of view, allowing prompt replies via voice commands or subtle finger gestures using the companion ring.

The smart ring supports tap, double-tap, slide, and long-press controls. It enables users to flip pages on a teleprompter, control media playback, snap photos, and confirm AI requests without needing to touch the glasses frame or speak in public settings.

title_zh: Google 发布世界模型 Genie 4：支持原生音频，模拟时长延长至两分钟
content_zh:
Google DeepMind 昨日发布新一代世界模型 Genie 4，支持实时生成画面、原生音频和物理模拟，单次交互模拟时长约为两分钟，较上一代的约一分钟有所延长。

用户输入一段文字即可生成可探索的虚拟世界，并通过键盘控制角色移动、调整镜头。在运行过程中，用户还能继续输入提示词，改变天气、添加人物或物体。

Genie 4 首次支持原生音频生成，可实时生成环境声音、音乐和人物对话，虚拟角色能根据用户输入和场景变化动态生成语言与反应。

物理模拟方面，谷歌展示了西瓜受冲击、枫树种子飘落、拥挤的乡村火车站等案例，涉及碰撞、空气动力学、重力和复杂人群行为。

🔗 相关阅读：刚刚，谷歌 Genie 4 发布，120 秒的世界却让我看见 AI 的未来
title_en: Google DeepMind Unveils Genie 4 World Model with Native Audio and Extended Simulations
content_en:
Google DeepMind has unveiled Genie 4, its next-generation world model capable of generating real-time interactive environments complete with physical simulation and native audio. The new iteration doubles its continuous simulation duration to roughly two minutes.

Users can construct explorable virtual worlds from simple text prompts, controlling character movements and camera angles using a keyboard. Mid-session prompting allows creators to dynamically alter weather conditions, spawn objects, or insert new characters on the fly.

A key upgrade in Genie 4 is native audio synthesis, generating real-time ambient sounds, background music, and contextual dialogue. Additionally, the model demonstrates advanced physics capabilities, accurately simulating collisions, aerodynamics, gravity, and complex crowd behaviors.

title_zh: 微信输入法新增「AI 录音笔」，录音可实时整理成结构化网页
content_zh:
微信派介绍，微信输入法新增「AI 录音笔」能力，可将录音实时转写为结构化网页，并按上下文整理重点和逻辑。

功能除了转成文字，还能修正错别字、删去冗余口头表达，并根据内容生成图表、图示和交互原型。微信派展示了会议纪要、直播内容回顾、家庭事务和旅行讨论等整理场景，总结页面可通过右上角的「分享」按钮发给好友。

手机端可从键盘工具栏或微信输入法 App 进入；电脑端可通过快捷键、Mac 顶部菜单栏或 Windows 工具栏打开。该功能支持多端同步，关联设备之间可以同步历史录音总结，用户可在最新版微信输入法中体验。
title_en: WeChat Keyboard Adds AI Voice Recorder Feature for Real-Time Structured Summaries
content_en:
WeChat Keyboard has introduced a new "AI Voice Recorder" feature that transforms spoken audio into structured web pages in real time, automatically organizing key information and logical structure.

Beyond basic transcription, the tool corrects typos, removes filler words, and automatically generates visual elements such as charts, diagrams, and interactive prototypes. Designed for meeting minutes, livestream recaps, and daily planning, the resulting summaries can be shared directly with WeChat contacts.

The feature supports cross-platform synchronization across mobile and desktop devices, enabling users to access and sync their recording histories seamlessly across linked hardware.

title_zh: 百度开源 Unlimited OCR 2，称可一次解析 3600 页《哈利·波特》
content_zh:
百度 10 月 27 日发布并开源文心 Unlimited OCR 2，主打超长文档的连续解析。百度称，模型可在一次任务中处理《哈利·波特》全系列 7 部作品、合计超过 3600 页，在文档增长后保持较稳定的解析精度与处理效率。

其核心是稀疏参考滑动窗口注意力机制 SR-SWA：先由页面门控缩小相关页面范围，再选取关键视觉 Token，减少对整份文档重复计算。配合无限解码机制，模型将单步解码所需的计算和显存开销控制在较稳定的范围内。

百度公布的 MPDocBench 和 MarathonDocBench 综合得分分别为 84.6 和 77.1。代码和模型权重已在 GitHub、Hugging Face 开放，开发者可使用 Transformers 或 SGLang 推理；百度智能云和 AI 开放平台也已上线相关能力。
title_en: Baidu Open-Sources Unlimited OCR 2 for Processing Ultra-Long Documents
content_en:
Baidu has open-sourced ERNIE Unlimited OCR 2, a model built for continuous processing of ultra-long documents. The company claims the model can parse over 3,600 pages—equivalent to the complete *Harry Potter* series—in a single run while maintaining stable accuracy and performance.

The core architectural innovation is a Sparse Reference Sliding Window Attention (SR-SWA) mechanism. It uses page-gating to filter context and extract key visual tokens, preventing redundant computations across massive files. Combined with an infinite decoding design, the model keeps per-step compute and VRAM requirements predictable.

Baidu reported benchmark scores of 84.6 on MPDocBench and 77.1 on MarathonDocBench. Model weights and source code are available on GitHub and Hugging Face, alongside deployment options on Baidu AI Cloud.

title_zh: 灵光 2.0 全面开放，可持续盯价、记住前情并跟进事务
content_zh:
蚂蚁推出灵光 2.0，将其定位为「能管事的 AI 助理」，从单轮对话扩展到持续跟进的个人 Agent。用户关掉 App 后，任务仍可在独立云主机及其浏览器中运行，并在有结果或需要决策时提醒用户。

APPSO 的体验中，灵光可读取宠物保险合同、整理报销条件并设置后续提醒，也能记住此前沟通的情况；购物时可比较同款商品在不同平台的价格、折算优惠，并持续跟踪价格变化。旅行人数或天气变化后，它还能基于已有偏好调整路线和安排。

灵光 2.0 支持用户授权接入支付宝账单等服务，整理周期性扣款和消费记录，也可连接钉钉、飞书等工具。在这些体验场景中，信息整理、提醒和后续跟进由 AI 承担，最终决定仍交给用户。

🔗 相关阅读：中国版 Muse 能管事！我把宠物保单、双 11 算价和周末旅行全交给了灵光 2.0
title_en: Ant Group Launches Lingguang 2.0 AI Agent with Persistent Task Tracking
content_en:
Ant Group has officially rolled out Lingguang 2.0, upgrading its AI assistant into a proactive personal agent capable of multi-step task follow-ups beyond single-turn conversations. Even after users close the app, tasks continue running in dedicated cloud environments, notifying users whenever actionable results or decisions are required.

The updated agent retains long-term context from past interactions and excels at complex daily workflows. It can parse pet insurance contracts to outline reimbursement terms, track and compare product prices across e-commerce platforms, and dynamically adjust travel itineraries based on weather or group size changes.

With user authorization, Lingguang 2.0 integrates with services like Alipay to manage recurring bills and connects with productivity tools such as DingTalk and Feishu. While the AI handles background organization, monitoring, and reminders, final decision-making remains in the hands of the user.

title_zh: 英伟达 RTX 路径追踪工具更新，新增 Windows on Arm 支持
content_zh:
英伟达 RTX Path Tracing 工具已更新至 1.9.0。官方发布记录显示，新版相较 1.8.1 在画质相当或更好的条件下，整体性能约提升 20%，并新增 Windows on ARM64 支持。

本次优化包括将部分路径追踪任务与 DLSS 光线重建、后处理放在异步计算队列中重叠执行，在实例较多的场景降低 CPU 帧耗时，并减少加速结构的内存占用。

新版还默认启用 SHaRC 辐射缓存，以相近成本提供更多间接光照；NEE-AT 可处理的光源数量由 51.2 万提升至 200 万。该工具面向开发者提供实时路径追踪的示例和参考实现，1.9.0 的官方版本记录发布于 10 月 23 日。
title_en: Nvidia RTX Path Tracing SDK 1.9.0 Adds Windows on Arm Support and Performance Boosts
content_en:
Nvidia has released version 1.9.0 of its RTX Path Tracing SDK, delivering a roughly 20% performance boost over version 1.8.1 while maintaining or enhancing image quality. Notably, this update introduces native support for Windows on ARM64.

Key technical optimizations include overlapping path tracing tasks with DLSS Ray Reconstruction and post-processing in asynchronous compute queues. This approach reduces CPU frame times in geometry-heavy scenes and lowers memory overhead for acceleration structures.

Additionally, the SHaRC spatial hash radiance cache is now enabled by default to deliver rich indirect lighting efficiently. The NEE-AT light sampling system has also been upgraded, expanding its capacity to process up to 2 million light sources, up from 512,000.

title_zh: 富士 mini Evo 2 加入触屏与短片，11 月 27 日起发售
content_zh:
富士发布混合型拍立得相机 instax mini Evo 2，保留数码拍摄后挑选照片打印的方式，首次为 instax 系列加入触摸屏，4.5 英寸屏幕可用于调整设置及滑动浏览照片。

根据富士日本总部 10 月 27 日公告，新机最高照片分辨率提升至 1300 万像素，使用这一分辨率需插入 microSD 卡，并关闭「Expanded View」扩展取景模式。扩展取景可在屏幕中显示打印画框之外的区域，帮助判断移动主体何时进入构图。

新增「Immersive Movie」功能用于记录按下快门前的拍摄瞬间，生成 5 秒、9:16 竖屏短片。短片可在相机上回看，也可通过专用 App 传输至手机；相机仍保留 10 种镜头效果和 10 种胶片效果的组合。

mini Evo 2 将于 11 月 27 日起发售。富士北美公布的美国建议零售价为 289.95 美元。
title_en: Fujifilm Unveils Instax Mini Evo 2 with Touchscreen and Short Video Capture
content_en:
Fujifilm has announced the Instax Mini Evo 2 hybrid instant camera. Retaining the popular workflow of shooting digitally before printing, the new model introduces a 4.5-inch touchscreen—a first for the Instax lineup—allowing users to easily adjust settings and swipe through photos.

The camera upgrades its maximum image resolution to 13 megapixels, accessible when using a microSD card and disabling the new "Expanded View" framing feature. It also introduces "Immersive Movie," a feature that records a 5-second 9:16 vertical video snippet right before the shutter press, which can be previewed on the device or transferred to smartphones.

Maintaining its classic creative appeal, the camera retains the combination of 10 lens effects and 10 film effects. The Instax Mini Evo 2 is scheduled to launch on November 27 at a suggested retail price of $289.95 USD in North America.

title_zh: 影石 Luna Ultra 获 Wirecutter 便携 Vlog 相机推荐
content_zh:
《纽约时报》旗下 Wirecutter 在更新的《最佳 Vlog 相机及设备》指南中，将影石 Luna Ultra 列为便携、可随身携带的相机推荐，并建议希望获得一体化拍摄方案的创作者选择其创作者套装。

这份指南于 10 月 14 日更新。Wirecutter 看重的组合包括口袋机身内的云台防抖、主体追踪，以及可拆卸的 2 英寸 OLED 触屏。屏幕取下后可充当无线监看与遥控器，方便高举相机或从特殊机位拍摄；套装麦克风则在嘈杂场景下接受了人声收音测试。

指南提到，Luna Ultra 支持最高 8K 30 帧及 4K 120 帧录制，并提供 10-bit I-Log。其单机续航实测约 2 小时 45 分钟，搭配电池手柄可再延长约 1 小时。

Wirecutter 也指出，主摄视角未必适合大合影，数字变焦越深入，画质损失越明显；需要更宽视野或更多镜头选择的拍摄者，可考虑其他相机类型。
title_en: Insta360 Luna Ultra Earns Wirecutter Recommendation for Portable Vlogging
content_en:
The New York Times' product review site, Wirecutter, has added the Insta360 Luna Ultra to its updated "Best Vlog Cameras and Gear" guide, highlighting it as a top pick for portable vlogging. The guide also recommends the Creator Combo for content creators seeking an all-in-one filming solution.

Wirecutter praised the camera's compact design, built-in gimbal stabilization, subject tracking, and a detachable 2-inch OLED touchscreen that doubles as a wireless monitor and remote control. For audio, the included wireless microphone was successfully tested for voice clarity in noisy environments.

On the performance side, the Luna Ultra supports up to 8K video at 30fps and 4K at 120fps with 10-bit I-Log support. Standalone battery life reaches roughly 2 hours and 45 minutes, with an additional hour provided by the battery grip. However, Wirecutter noted that the main lens's field of view may not suit wide group shots and that digital zoom causes noticeable quality loss.

title_zh: 魏牌二代蓝山首秀，改用方盒子造型并提供五座、六座版本
content_zh:
魏牌二代蓝山于 10 月 27 日亮相，新车采用方盒子造型，提供五座和六座版本，动力改为 2.0T 插电式混合动力系统。

据《汽车行业关注》报道，新车使用直瀑式格栅、复古圆形大灯及外挂备胎，尾门采用侧开设计，车顶配有激光雷达。五座版车长为 5140mm，六座版加长至 5300mm，宽度、高度分别为 2050mm 和 1960mm，两种版本轴距均为 3010mm。

报道援引申报信息称，发动机最大功率为 182kW，前、后电机功率分别为 110kW 和 220kW。两种电池容量分别为 53.6kWh 和 64.7kWh，对应申报纯电续航 220 公里和 270 公里。
title_en: Next-Gen WEY Lanshan Debuts with Boxy Styling and 2.0T PHEV Powertrain
content_en:
WEY unveiled the second-generation Lanshan SUV on October 27, featuring a rugged, boxy exterior design and offering both five-seat and six-seat configurations powered by a 2.0T plug-in hybrid electric vehicle (PHEV) system.

The redesigned model sports a waterfall front grille, retro round headlights, an external spare tire, a side-opening tailgate, and a roof-mounted LiDAR sensor. Both seating variants share a 3,010 mm wheelbase, a width of 2,050 mm, and a height of 1,960 mm, with the five-seater measuring 5,140 mm in length and the six-seater extending to 5,300 mm.

According to regulatory filings, the powertrain pairs a 182 kW engine with 110 kW front and 220 kW rear electric motors. Battery options include 53.6 kWh and 64.7 kWh packs, offering claimed pure-electric ranges of 220 km and 270 km, respectively.

title_zh: 《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》迎来最后一次大型更新，加入五轮新游戏＋
content_zh:
育碧宣布，《刺客信条：黑旗 记忆重置》最后一次大型内容更新将于北京时间 10 月 27 日 22 时推送，面向全平台加入「新游戏＋」、噩梦难度及新收集内容，后续数月还会继续提供体验优化更新。

新游戏＋可继承爱德华的工具、升级、已解锁武器，以及寒鸦号升级、已解锁船员技能和宠物等内容。玩家需要重新招募船员、夺取要塞，地图迷雾也会重置。每轮重玩会增加精英士兵和高等级巡逻船，最多可开启五轮新游戏＋，并加入专属货币兑换新装扮。

噩梦模式会提高敌人伤害、缩短格挡时机，并关闭防止单次致命攻击的保护机制；潜行中敌人发现玩家更快，水下生物伤害和氧气消耗也会增加。

更新还恢复了原版部分处决动作，加入隐藏社区宝箱、新服装及宠物外观。
title_en: Assassin's Creed: Black Flag - Memory Reset Receives Final Major Update with New Game+
content_en:
Ubisoft has released the final major content update for *Assassin's Creed: Black Flag - Memory Reset*, introducing a New Game+ mode, a Nightmare difficulty setting, and fresh collectibles across all platforms. Additional quality-of-life updates will continue to roll out over the coming months.

The New Game+ mode allows players to carry over Edward's tools, upgrades, unlocked weapons, Jackdaw ship enhancements, crew skills, and pets into a new playthrough. However, players must re-recruit their crew and recapture forts as the map fog resets. Players can progress through up to five NG+ cycles, with each tier featuring tougher elite enemies and higher-level patrol ships, as well as an exclusive currency for new cosmetic unlocks.

For an extra challenge, Nightmare difficulty increases enemy damage, tightens parry timing, removes fatal-hit protections, and heightens enemy awareness and underwater hazards. The update also restores original execution animations, introduces hidden community chests, and adds new character outfits and pet skins.

title_zh: 蚂蚁百灵开源 Ling-3.1 增强版，支持 100 万 Token 上下文
content_zh:
蚂蚁百灵开源 Ling-3.1-flash-1019 模型权重，采用 MIT 许可证，支持 100 万 Token 上下文。模型总参数为 5600 亿，每个 Token 激活 250 亿参数，采用混合线性 MoE 架构。

官方模型卡称，新版通过进一步后训练加强推理与智能体任务能力，Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 得分由前代的 41 提升至 44，AutomationBench-AA 得分由 62% 提升至 68%；这些是模型卡列出的评测结果。

部署文档提供 SGLang 与 vLLM 路径，支持思考开关、工具调用及 MTP 推测解码。官方推荐的 SGLang 示例使用 8 张 H200，并列出 4 张 GB300 的配置方式，主要面向服务端部署。
title_en: Ant Group Open-Sources Enhanced Ling-3.1 Model with 1-Million-Token Context Window
content_en:
Ant Group's Bailing team has open-sourced the weights for Ling-3.1-flash-1019 under the permissive MIT license. Featuring a massive 1-million-token context window, the model adopts a hybrid linear Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architecture with 560 billion total parameters, activating 25 billion parameters per token.

Official evaluations show that post-training enhancements have significantly improved its reasoning and agentic performance. The updated model scored 44 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2 (up from 41) and saw its AutomationBench-AA score rise from 62% to 68%.

Tailored for server-side deployment, the release provides integration paths for SGLang and vLLM, featuring support for tool calling, reasoning toggles, and multi-token prediction (MTP) speculative decoding. Recommended hardware configurations include 8× H200 or 4× GB300 GPUs.

title_zh: Liquid AI 发布 LFM3，小模型覆盖文本、图像、语音与决策
content_zh:
Liquid AI 发布 LFM3 系列，首批 6 款模型均处于约 20 亿参数规模，覆盖文本、视觉、音频、全模态及决策任务，共用 LFM3-1.7B 基础骨干，权重已在 Hugging Face 上线。

文本模型 LFM3-1.7B 支持 256K Token 上下文，4-bit 精度下约占 1GB 内存，可在手机和笔记本上本地运行，也能通过单张 GPU 微调。新架构结合门控短卷积、滑动窗口注意力和全局注意力，预训练使用了 22 万亿 Token；模型面向本地智能体、工具调用和特定任务定制。

官方模型卡同时给出适用边界：受规模限制，不推荐将文本模型用于复杂多步推理或智能体编程。系列采用自定义的 LFM Open License v1.0，商业使用受营收门槛限制。
title_en: Liquid AI Unveils LFM3 Series: Edge-Friendly 2B Models Across Text, Vision, Audio, and Decision-Making
content_en:
Liquid AI has launched its LFM3 model series, featuring six lightweight models operating around the 2-billion-parameter scale. The lineup covers text, vision, audio, omni-modal, and decision-making tasks, all sharing the unified LFM3-1.7B backbone. Weights are now publicly available on Hugging Face.

The flagship text model, LFM3-1.7B, supports a 256K-token context window and requires roughly 1GB of RAM at 4-bit quantization, allowing it to run natively on smartphones and laptops or be fine-tuned on a single GPU. Pre-trained on 22 trillion tokens, its architecture combines gated short convolutions with sliding-window and global attention mechanism.

While tailored for local agents and specialized tasks, Liquid AI notes that due to size limitations, the text model is not recommended for complex multi-step reasoning or programming agents. The series is released under the custom LFM Open License v1.0, which imposes revenue thresholds for commercial use.

title_zh: Omdia：英国微短剧观众中，男性占 54%
content_zh:
Omdia 最新消费者研究显示，男性占英国微短剧用户的 54%。在受调查市场的微短剧用户中，男性占比为 47%，美国、西班牙、巴西分别为 50%、47% 和 29%，地区差异明显。

这项调查于今年 4 月开展。Omdia 媒体与娱乐业务主管 María Rúa Aguete 表示，行业长期把微短剧与女性观众、爱情题材联系在一起，可能低估了它的受众范围。随着市场扩大，喜剧、惊悚、犯罪和动作题材也有增长机会。

Omdia 预测，2026 年全球微短剧市场收入约为 140 亿美元，到 2031 年将接近 250 亿美元。该机构认为，下一阶段的增长需要理解不同市场的受众构成，并据此调整题材、营销和变现方式。
title_en: Men Account for 54% of Short-Form Drama Viewers in the UK, Omdia Study Finds
content_en:
A recent consumer study by market research firm Omdia reveals that men make up 54% of short-form drama viewers in the UK. Across all surveyed global markets, men represent an average of 47% of the audience, with distinct regional variation—including 50% in the US, 47% in Spain, and 29% in Brazil.

María Rúa Aguete, Senior Director at Omdia, highlighted that the industry has long associated short-form dramas primarily with female audiences and romance genres, likely underestimating broader market reach. As audience demographics expand, genres such as comedy, thriller, crime, and action present significant growth opportunities.

Omdia projects global revenue for the short-form drama market to reach $14 billion by 2026 and approach $25 billion by 2031. The firm emphasizes that capturing the next phase of growth will depend on tailored content strategy, targeted marketing, and localized monetization across different regions.

title_zh: 泡泡玛特第三季度收益同比降 45%—50%，海外市场降幅更大
content_zh:
泡泡玛特 10 月 27 日公布第三季度业务更新，未经审核的整体收益较去年同期下降 45%—50%，各地区均出现下滑。

其中，中国市场收益同比下降 25%—30%；亚太、美洲、欧洲及其他地区分别下降 65%—70%、70%—75% 和 50%—55%。公告中的亚太地区不包含中国。

中国市场的渠道表现也有差异：线下渠道收益同比下降 5%—10%，线上渠道下降 45%—50%。这份更新披露的是收益同比变动区间，并非净利润降幅。
title_en: Pop Mart Q3 Revenue Plunges up to 50% Amid Steep International Decline
content_en:
Pop Mart released its Q3 business update on October 27, revealing an unaudited total revenue decline of 45% to 50% year-over-year. The downturn affected all geographic regions, with overseas markets suffering the most severe drops.

In China, overall revenue fell between 25% and 30%. Broken down by sales channels within China, offline revenue declined moderately by 5% to 10%, while online revenue plummeted 45% to 50%.

International performance showed sharper contractions. Revenue dropped 65% to 70% in the Asia-Pacific region (excluding China), 70% to 75% in the Americas, and 50% to 55% across Europe and other markets. The company emphasized that these figures reflect revenue changes rather than net profit margins.

title_zh: 红果已处置 20426 部低质同质化短剧，重点治理「换皮」与撞脸
content_zh:
红果短剧 10 月 27 日发布公告，称已集中处置存在低质和同质化问题的微短剧共 20426 部，并将进一步治理刻意渲染矛盾、剧情内容同质化及人物素材同质化三类问题。

剧情治理针对核心设定、人物关系、关键桥段和推进手法高度相似，仅替换局部细节，或跨剧集、跨账号批量「换皮」的内容。对家庭、邻里、职场冲突，平台也将治理缺少合理铺垫和人物塑造、机械堆叠争吵与反转的做法。

人物素材方面，公告点名批量套用同一人脸模型、五官模板，造成不同作品与角色在脸型、妆造和整体辨识度上高度相似的「多人同脸」「跨剧撞脸」。平台呼吁创作者坚持原创，避免模板化生产。
title_en: Hongguo Short Drama Removes Over 20,000 Low-Quality Titles in Crackdown on 'Reskinned' Content
content_en:
Hongguo Short Drama announced on October 27 that it has taken down 20,426 low-quality and repetitive short dramas. The platform is launching a targeted campaign against forced plot conflicts, repetitive storylines, and recycled character assets.

The cleanup targets narrative "reskinning"—where creators alter minor details while copying core setups, character dynamics, and key plot points across multiple series or accounts. The platform is also curbing dramatized workplace, family, and neighborhood disputes that rely on forced twists without proper narrative setup.

Additionally, Hongguo highlighted issues with AI-generated character assets, specifically the mass reuse of identical facial models and makeup templates that create indistinguishable characters across different shows. The platform urged creators to prioritize original work and move away from formulaic production.

title_zh: HBO 接手开发剧版《群鸟》，《继承之战》莎拉·斯努克主演
content_zh:
HBO 拿下限定剧《群鸟》（The Birds）开发项目，由《继承之战》演员莎拉·斯努克主演。Deadline 报道，这一改编由环球全球电视工作室在今年夏天推向市场，现已落脚 HBO。

新版取材于希区柯克电影与达芙妮·杜穆里埃的同名小说，将故事放到当代，加入谋杀悬案与全新人物。斯努克饰演的 Myra Massey 为躲避抚养权纠纷，带女儿返回家乡，暗中调查童年好友失踪事件，随后遭遇与案件相连的致命鸟群袭击。

试播集由《守望者》《守望尘世》执行制片人 Tom Spezialy 编剧，制片团队还包括新版《哈利·波特》剧集的 David Heyman。斯努克也担任执行制片人。
title_en: HBO Lands 'The Birds' Series Adaptation Starring 'Succession' Breakout Sarah Snook
content_en:
HBO has acquired the development rights for a limited series adaptation of *The Birds*, with *Succession* star Sarah Snook attached to play the lead. The project, packaged by Universal International Studios, landed at HBO following a competitive market pitch this summer.

Based on Daphne du Maurier's classic novella and Alfred Hitchcock's iconic film adaptation, the contemporary reimagining introduces a modern murder mystery. Snook stars as Myra Massey, a woman who flees a custody battle with her daughter and returns to her hometown. While secretly investigating her childhood friend's disappearance, she faces deadly bird attacks tied to the mystery.

Tom Spezialy (*Watchmen*, *The Leftovers*) is writing the pilot episode. The executive production team features David Heyman (*Harry Potter*) alongside Snook, who also serves as executive producer.
